decisions.statement: The picture's id is the first word.
The file is named for the id and carries the extension of the image kept.
A path said here is written instead of the file under the home folder.
Whether an object store is there is settled before anything is written.
An id nothing is kept under is answered as missing data rather than as a wrong call.
The answer names the path written, so a reader can open that file.

definition: the command bringing a picture Alan's phone sent to a file on this machine
